neighbours.label: promises that seem too good to be true: 'too good to be true', easy money, gain with no effort
fire: The offer looked too good to be true, so she walked away.
Be careful: if it seems too good, it probably is.
They promised huge profits with no work at all.
He fell for a scheme of quick and easy cash.
Lose weight overnight with zero effort!
That deal sounds too good to be true.
Everyone wants easy money and instant wealth.
Get rich at home with no effort and no risk.
quiet: The offer looked too small to be useful, so she walked away.
Be careful: if it seems too hot, it probably is.
They promised modest profits after years of work.
He worked on a scheme of slow and steady saving.
Lose weight slowly with diet and exercise.
That deal sounds too long to be read.
Everyone wants fair pay and a steady job.
Get fit at home with a mat and some weights.

short: too good to be true, easy gain
notes: Card: ' easy' 7, ' good' and ' be' in 'too good to be true'. Probes: 'too good to be true' 1.05, 'too good,' 0.92, 'free money with no effort' 1.04, 'quick and easy money' 0.57; 'too late' 0.05, 'easy for the whole class' 0.06, 'free trial' 0.02, but 'too loud to be heard' 0.60 on ' too', so one near miss here copies that shape. The word 'perpetual' (0.59) is not covered.
